items.problem: For a client log request that ends with `INVALID_REQUEST` in the handler (event `name` or param `key` not snake_case, or `core_` name, logging.md:109), it is not set whether the handler still passes `client_dropped_count` (and minimum level `warn` when it is more than 0) with `annotate_request_log` before failing. logging.md:113 adds `dropped_event_count` to "that request's `request` log" with no exception, logging.md:110 to logging.md:112 apply only to saved requests, and logging.md:50 keeps annotations after rollback, so both behaviors fit the text. Input: `ReportAnalyticsEvents` with one event named `core_x` and `dropped_event_count` 3 can log level `info` with no count fields, or level `warn` with `client_dropped_count` 3. In the same way, logging.md:90 lists `dropped_count`, `client_dropped_count`, `consent_dropped_count` as fields of the client log `rpc` `request` log, but it is not set whether they are absent, `null` or 0 when `routing` ends the request before the handler runs (no session, `RATE_LIMITED` at logging.md:278, field validation `INVALID_REQUEST` at logging.md:108)
